From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>

Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Optimize toolkit: packaging options & initial proposal

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — appreciate the deep dive on Helix's inference footprint and the cross-team use cases. Per our conversation, I pulled together three packaging options for Redwood's Optimize toolkit (focus areas: batching & prefix/KV caching policies, quantization recommendations & validation, and ongoing tuning cadence). The attached SOW and pricing workbook have line items, but summary below: 

- Optimize Advisor (pilot): $2,000 / month + 5,000 credits (recommended for single-team trials). 4-week onboarding, includes 2 sprints of tuning and one quantization feasibility check.
- Optimize Pro (recommended for scale): $7,000 / month + 50,000 credits. 6-week onboarding, quantization profiles (INT8/FP16 where applicable), automated batching rules, monthly report + quarterly business review.
- Enterprise Bundle: custom pricing for multi-team deployments with SLA and extended support. Baseline: Pro x3 + implementation work (itemized in workbook).

Estimated impact for the workloads you shared: we expect 20–35% reduction in token spend from smarter batching/caching alone; quantization can add another 10–25% depending on acceptable latency/quality tradeoffs. The workbook includes a sample savings model for Helix's 200M tokens/month scenario.

Volume/term incentives: 12-month commit = 18% off list + 60k one-time token credit; 6-month commit = 10% off. One-time onboarding fee: $12,000 (can be applied as credits toward first month on 12-month deals).

Next steps: would you be open to a short call early next week to walk the SOW and confirm which teams/pipelines to include in the Enterprise Bundle? I can also run a quick test to validate expected percent savings on a representative dataset if you share a small sample or allow our staging access.

Attachments: Optimize_Toolkit_SOW_v2.pdf, Optimize_Toolkit_Pricing_v3.xlsx

Best,

Team — forwarding Helix's questions. Procurement is pushing hard on a 35% discount for a 12-month commitment. They are strategic: three product teams, steady volume, and could move to Dedicated/Private in 2027 if performance/economics are good.

My proposal for negotiation:
- Counteroffer: 22% off list on a 12-month Enterprise Bundle (vs. our standard 18%).
- Increase token credit to 60k one-time applied on first invoice (visible line item).
- Reduce onboarding fee to $8k (we absorb implementation delta).
- Include a quantization validation deliverable: clear quality/regression report (A/B on a holdout prompt set), and run tests in Helix staging; if model changes required, chargeable at time-and-materials (we estimate low probability).
- Add 90-day success metric: 15% realized token savings threshold or we commit to follow-up tuning at no extra retainer for one sprint.

Rationale: preserves margin, shows flexibility, ties savings to measurable outcome which helps procurement sign-off. Need sign-off from you (Rishi) on discount authority and from Marissa on whether we can commit to the 90-day metric and quant validation scope. Also, can Legal quickly review the addendum to ensure the success metric is non-penalizing?

Attachments: internal_pricing_notes.md

Thanks —
Monica
